supporting_observations.claim: WS-BCARTER-01 made repeated connections to the internal proxy at 10.30.20.30:8080, with observed start times roughly 4–6 minutes apart from 13:30 through 14:06 UTC. Examples include 13:30:03, 13:36:22, 13:41:10, 13:46:34, 13:51:47, 13:55:57, 14:01:14, and 14:06:22.
The listed periodic-activity records identify connections from the workstation to the proxy, but do not identify the external HTTPS destination or the originating process.
The cadence is compatible with the inventory's stated approximately five-minute ChartMate updater checks, but the available records do not establish that ChartMate generated these connections.

known_telemetry_limitations: The periodic-flow records show connections to the internal proxy, not the proxy's external destination; no matching proxy CONNECT or request details for those flows are present in the supplied records.
The supplied records do not correlate the periodic proxy connections to a process, executable, or user session.
Connection timing and byte counts alone do not reveal the content or purpose of the proxied traffic.
claims_not_established: Which external host or service received the periodic HTTPS requests.
Whether the periodic traffic was generated by the approved ChartMate updater or by another application.
Whether the traffic carried benign update-check data, sensitive data, or malicious content.
Whether the periodic activity was malicious.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve proxy logs for the listed connection times, including CONNECT destinations, request details if inspected, and client source-port correlation.
Obtain endpoint process/network telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 around the periodic connection times to identify the initiating executable and user.
Confirm whether ChartMate is installed and whether its updater was scheduled or active on WS-BCARTER-01 during this interval.
unrelated_findings: Separate from the alert, WS-BCARTER-01 made an SMB connection to DC-HD-01 on port 445 and DC-HD-01 logged a network logon for the workstation machine account. The supplied records do not show the share or files accessed; validate separately if this is atypical for the environment (T005-00141, T005-00145).
